name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 10, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Chaplain Christopher Merris, Balboa Naval Hospital Medical Center
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring February 2009 "National Association for the Advancement of Colored People Month" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Presentation by Dan McAllister, San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector.
P3.
Presentation regarding BioSolids by Mike Hogan, Encina Wastewater Authority General Manager.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C3.
Fire Station No. 1 Design Amendment and Construction Support Services (CC)
C4.
Grapevine Road Street Easement Purchases (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with Joe and Ruby Hernandez for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 845 Grapevine Road;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with Gloria V. Dahl for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 849 Grapevine Road; and
3.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving an acquisition agreement with David John Collier and Kathleen Renee Collier as Trustees of the CKK Trust dated December 9, 2006, for the purchase of a Public Street & Utility Easement at 413 Grapevine Road.
C5.
No Parking Zone on Warmlands Avenue at Alessandro Trail (CC)
C6.
State-Local Partnership Program Grant Applications (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , supporting two competitive applications to the California Transportation Commission's State-Local Partnership Program; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , supporting three formula grant applications to the California Transportation Commission's State-Local Partnership Program.
C7.
Historical Society Lease Agreement (CC)
C8.
Urban Area Security Initiative (UASI) Grant Funds (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , accepting UASI grant funds of $1,425,773 from the Department of Homeland Security and amending the Operating Budget for FY 2008-2009; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the Memorandum of Understanding with the City of San Diego.
C9.
Loading Zone Installation and Red Zone Removal on Alta Vista Drive (CC)
C10.
Two-Hour Time Limit Parking and No Parking Zones on W. Vista Way (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
FY 2008/2009 Second Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending FY 2008/2009 Operating and Capital Improvement Program Budgets; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , amending the FY 2008/2009 Operating Budget.
D2.
Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2009-2010 through FY 2013-2014 (CC/CDC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- , transferring unused appropriations for certain Capital Improvement Project accounts to fund balance or retained earnings; and
2.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , transferring unused appropriations for certain Capital Improvement Project accounts to retained earnings; and
3.
Resolutions approving the Capital Improvement Program for FY 2009-2010 through FY 2013-2104, and authorizing appropriations for FY 2009-2010
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- ,
b.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2009- ; and
c.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009-
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Zoning Code Amendment Regarding Commercial Uses (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving a Negative Declaration for a zoning code amendment regarding commercial land use regulations;
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18 of the Development Code and Specific Plan No. 26, the Townsite Specific Plan, and the North County Square Specific Plan, Relating to Commercial Uses"; and (Continued on following page)
(Continued from previous page)
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2009- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 5, Chapter 5.56, Section 5.56.040 of the Vista Municipal Code Relating to Massage Establishments and Massage Therapist."
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
